_comment: User-study picks after visual inspection of every iteration preview (not only the critic). run = output dir on scratch; B = iter_<iter>_av.mp4 (16 steps, same noise as baseline_av.mp4) or optimized_final_av.mp4 when iter = 'final'.

goldfish.note: clean leap out of the tank; baseline never jumps
goldfish.edit: The goldfish jumps out of the fish tank into the air.

cat_yawns.note: wide early yawn (frames ~30-50); baseline yawns only in the last frame. alt: iter 9

man_shouts.note: hands come up from mid-clip and an open-mouth shout; baseline raises hands only in the last frames

man_celebrates.edit: The man raises both arms in celebration.
man_celebrates.note: both arms raised fully above the head from mid-clip (frames ~50-90); baseline lifts the hands only slightly in the last frames. alt: iter 6 (arms up earlier, frames ~30-80)
